The martyrs rejoice in the bounty and grace of Allah upon them, and that He does not waste the reward of the believers, for He gives them the best of reward in Paradise. The reciters differed over the reading, but the meaning is that the martyr is given glad tidings of the grace of Allah and the full reward of the believers, and that is a great honor. And the martyrs rejoice in what Allah has promised them. And they are alive in the gardens of Paradise.

phrases.ar: ۞ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ بِنِعۡمَةٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَضۡلٖ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
phrases.translation: They are joyful for receiving Allah’s grace and bounty, and that Allah does not deny the reward of the believers
phrases.explanation: "They are joyful for receiving Allah's grace and bounty, and that Allah does not deny the reward of the believers." "Rejoice": the martyrs are glad at the grace and bounty of Allah and at the fact that He does not let the reward of the believers go to waste. The reciters differed over the ending, but all agree that the believer's reward is preserved with Allah and will not be diminished, and the martyr rejoices in it. So the believer should rejoice in the promise of Allah. And He will give them their reward in full on the Day of Judgment. And that is better for them than anything of this world.

phrases.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلۡقَرۡحُۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ وَٱتَّقَوۡاْ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٌ
phrases.translation: ˹As for˺ those who responded to the call of Allah and His Messenger after their injury, those of them who did good and were mindful ˹of Allah˺ will have a great reward
phrases.explanation: "As for those who responded to the call of Allah and His Messenger after their injury, those of them who did good and were mindful: they will have a great reward." This refers in particular to those who went out with the Prophet to Hamra al-Asad after Uhud, in pursuit of the enemy, despite their wounds, responding to the call of Allah and His Messenger. Those of them who did good and feared Allah will have a great reward from Him, for Allah does not waste the reward of the doers of good, and responding to the call in hardship is among the greatest of deeds. And Allah loves those who respond to the call in hardship.

phrases.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدۡ جَمَعُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱخۡشَوۡهُمۡ فَزَادَهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَقَالُواْ حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ
phrases.translation: Those who were warned, “Your enemies have mobilized their forces against you, so fear them,” the warning only made them grow stronger in faith and they replied, “Allah ˹alone˺ is sufficient ˹as an aid˺ for us and ˹He˺ is the best Protector.”
phrases.explanation: "Those who were warned: Your enemies have mobilized their forces against you, so fear them, the warning only made them grow stronger in faith. They said: Allah is sufficient for us, and what a fine Guardian! So they returned with Allah's favours and grace, suffering no harm. For they sought to please Allah. And surely Allah is the Lord of great bounty." After Uhud, news came that the enemy had gathered to attack Medina again, and the hypocrites warned the believers to fear them, but the warning only increased the believers in faith, and they said: Allah suffices us and is the best guardian. So they went out and returned with the favor and bounty of Allah, having suffered no harm, for they sought the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is the Lord of great bounty, giving victory and safety to those who trust in Him. The hypocrites tried to discourage them by exaggerating the enemy, but the believers said: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best guardian, and their faith increased, for fear of Allah is better than fear of the enemy. They went out and Allah gave them victory without a fight, returning safely with His favors.

phrases.ar: فَٱنقَلَبُواْ بِنِعۡمَةٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَضۡلٖ لَّمۡ يَمۡسَسۡهُمۡ سُوٓءٞ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ رِضۡوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضۡلٍ عَظِيمٍ
phrases.translation: So they returned with Allah’s favours and grace, suffering no harm. For they sought to please Allah. And surely Allah is ˹the˺ Lord of infinite bounty
phrases.explanation: "So they returned with Allah's favours and grace, suffering no harm. For they sought to please Allah. And surely Allah is the Lord of great bounty." They returned from Hamra al-Asad with the grace and bounty of Allah, no evil touching them, because they sought the pleasure of Allah by going out despite the warning. And Allah is the Possessor of great bounty, and He rewards those who seek His pleasure with victory and safety, for He does not waste the reward of anyone. And whoever seeks the pleasure of Allah, Allah gives him of His bounty. So seek His pleasure in every deed. And He does not waste the reward of the doers of good.

phrases.ar: إِنَّمَا ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوۡلِيَآءَهُۥ فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمۡ وَخَافُونِ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
phrases.translation: That ˹warning˺ was only ˹from˺ Satan, trying to prompt you to fear his followers. So do not fear them; fear Me if you are ˹true˺ believers
phrases.explanation: "That warning was only from Satan, trying to prompt you to fear his followers. So do not fear them, fear Me if you are true believers." The warning that the enemy had gathered was only from Satan, who instills fear of his followers in the hearts of the hypocrites, magnifying the affair of the disbelievers. So do not fear them, O believers, but fear Allah alone, for the true believer fears Allah and not the enemy, and whoever fears Allah is safe. The exegetes said this was when a group tried to frighten the believers after Uhud by saying the enemy had gathered, but the believers answered that Allah suffices them, and their faith increased. Fear Allah and not the followers of Satan. The believer fears none but Allah. And He aids His friends. And He is the best of helpers.

phrases.ar: وَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡكُفۡرِۚ إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يَضُرُّواْ ٱللَّهَ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجۡعَلَ لَهُمۡ حَظّٗا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
phrases.translation: ˹O Prophet!˺ Do not grieve for those who race to disbelieve—surely they will not harm Allah in the least. It is Allah’s Will to disallow them a share in the Hereafter, and they will suffer a tremendous punishment
phrases.explanation: "O Prophet! Do not grieve for those who race to disbelieve, surely they will not harm Allah in the least. It is Allah's Will to disallow them any share of the Hereafter, and they will suffer a tremendous punishment." Allah consoles His Prophet: do not grieve over those who hasten into disbelief, for they cannot harm Allah at all, since He does not need their belief. He wills not to give them any portion in the Hereafter, and they will have a great punishment, for they chose disbelief after the truth came to them, and their hearts became hard. So do not grieve over their disbelief, for guidance is from Allah.

phrases.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ لَن يَضُرُّواْ ٱللَّهَ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
phrases.translation: Those who trade belief for disbelief will never harm Allah in the least, and they will suffer a painful punishment
phrases.explanation: "Those who trade belief for disbelief will never harm Allah in the least, and they will suffer a painful punishment." Those who bought disbelief with faith, preferring it, will not harm Allah anything, for He is above need of His creatures. And they will have a painful punishment in recompense for their disbelief, for they rejected the truth after knowing it. Their trade is a losing one, and they will regret it on the Day when they are requited for it. So do not follow their way, but hold fast to faith. And their end is the Fire, so turn away from disbelief. So hold fast to Islam and do not sell it for any price.

phrases.ar: وَلَا يَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا نُمۡلِي لَهُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لِّأَنفُسِهِمۡۚ إِنَّمَا نُمۡلِي لَهُمۡ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِثۡمٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
phrases.translation: Those who disbelieve should not think that living longer is good for them. They are only given more time to increase in sin, and they will suffer a humiliating punishment
phrases.explanation: "Those who disbelieve should not think that living longer is good for them. They are only given more time to increase in sin, and they will suffer a humiliating punishment." Let not the disbelievers think that the respite Allah grants them is good for them. He gives them time only so that they increase in sin, and their punishment will be greater for it, and it will be humiliating, for they prolonged their disobedience and did not repent. So do not be deceived by their long life, for it is a gradual seizure. So hasten to repentance before the respite ends. And the punishment of Allah is severe.

phrases.ar: مَّا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ حَتَّىٰ يَمِيزَ ٱلۡخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِۗ
phrases.translation: Allah would not leave the believers in the condition you were in, until He distinguished the good from the evil ˹among you˺. Nor would Allah ˹directly˺ reveal to you
phrases.explanation: "Allah would not leave the believers in the condition you were in, until He distinguished the good from the evil among you. Nor would Allah reveal the unseen to you, but Allah chooses from among you a messenger. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Allah would not leave the believers upon what they were, with the hypocrites mixed among them, until He separated the evil from the good by the trial of Uhud, where the hypocrites showed their true nature. Nor would He reveal the unseen to you, but He chooses a messenger to receive the revelation. And He is All-Forgiving and Merciful to the believers. The trial of Uhud exposed who was sincere. So be among the good.

phrases.ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُطۡلِعَكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡتَبِي مِن رُّسُلِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۖ فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۚ وَإِن تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ فَلَكُمۡ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ
phrases.translation: the unseen, but He chooses whoever He wills as a messenger. So believe in Allah and His messengers. And if you are faithful and mindful ˹of Allah˺, you will receive a great reward
phrases.explanation: "But Allah chooses from among you a messenger. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." The messenger is chosen from among the people to convey the revelation and the unseen news, and the believers obey him. And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful to His believing servants, forgiving their sins and accepting their repentance, so turn to Him and do not despair. So obey the Messenger and repent to Allah. And He accepts the repentance of His servants. And He is the best of givers. And the messenger is the best of those chosen, for he conveys the revelation and guides the people to the truth, so follow him and obey him, for in that is your success.

phrases.ar: وَلَا يَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَبۡخَلُونَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ هُوَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۖ بَلۡ هُوَ شَرّٞ لَّهُمۡۖ سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُواْ بِهِۦ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ وَلِلَّهِ
phrases.translation: And do not let those who ˹greedily˺ withhold Allah’s bounties think it is good for them—in fact, it is bad for them! They will be leashed ˹by their necks˺ on the Day of Judgment with whatever ˹wealth˺ they used to withhold. And Allah is the ˹sole˺
phrases.explanation: "And do not let those who greedily withhold Allah's bounties think it is good for them, in fact, it is bad for them! They will be loaded with their sins on the Day of Judgment, and for them is a humiliating punishment." The reciters differed over the verb form. Those who are stingy with the bounty Allah gave them, withholding charity from their wealth, should not think that withholding is good for them, for it is evil for them. On the Day of Judgment they will be strangled with what they withheld, that is, they will be recompensed for their stinginess, and they will have a humiliating punishment, for the miser hoards in this life and is punished in the next, while the generous is rewarded. The exegetes said the miser will be encircled on the Day of Judgment by what he withheld, as if wearing it like a collar of fire, and he will be humiliated before all creation for his stinginess, while the one who spends in the cause of Allah is honored. Allah forbade miserliness and enjoined generosity, for wealth is a trust from Allah and must be spent in His cause, and the Day of Judgment will reveal who was truly rich in good deeds. The Prophet taught that charity does not decrease wealth, and whoever forgives, Allah will honor him, and whoever is humble for the sake of Allah, Allah will raise him, so be generous and spend in the cause of Allah, for the wealth you withhold will be a regret for you on the Day of Judgment, and the wealth you spend will be a treasure for you with Allah. Spend then from the bounty of Allah upon you, on yourself, your family, and the poor, for He will replace it for you and reward you better, and do not let Satan promise you poverty and enjoin you to miserliness, for Allah promises you forgiveness and bounty, and Allah is all-Encompassing, All-Knowing.

phrases.ar: مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
phrases.translation: inheritor of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do
phrases.explanation: "They will be loaded with their sins on the Day of Judgment, and for them is a humiliating punishment. And Allah is not unaware of what you do." Allah is not unaware of what you do, whether you give in charity or withhold, and He will requite you for it, so give from what Allah has given you and do not be stingy, for Allah loves the generous and hates the miser. So do good and fear Allah. And do not withhold from your relatives and the needy. And He sees every deed. And fear the Day when you will be returned to Him. And He will requite every soul for what it earned.

phrases.ar: لَّقَدۡ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوۡلَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَقِيرٞ وَنَحۡنُ أَغۡنِيَآءُۘ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَالُواْ وَقَتۡلَهُمُ ٱلۡأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيۡرِ حَقّٖ
phrases.translation: Indeed, Allah has heard those ˹among the Jews˺ who said, “Allah is poor; we are rich!” We have certainly recorded their slurs and their killing of prophets unjustly.
phrases.explanation: "Indeed, Allah has heard those among the Jews who said: Allah is poor, we are rich! We have certainly recorded their slurs and their killing of prophets without right. And We will say: Taste the punishment of the Fire. That is the reward for what your hands have done. And Allah is never unjust to His creation." Allah heard the saying of some of the Jews who said: Allah is poor and we are rich, rejecting the obligation of charity. So Allah says: We have recorded what they said and their slaying of the prophets unjustly, and on the Day of Judgment We will say to them: taste the punishment of the Fire. That is the recompense of what their hands sent forth, namely their disbelief and their killing of the messengers, and Allah is never unjust to His servants, but they wronged themselves.

phrases.ar: وَنَقُولُ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
phrases.translation: Then We will say, “Taste the torment of burning
phrases.explanation: "That is the reward for what your hands have done. And Allah is never unjust to His creation." Allah says: that punishment is the reward of what your own hands earned, your disbelief and your crimes, and Allah does not wrong anyone, for He recompenses each according to his deeds, and the wrongdoer bears his own sin. And He will judge between all His servants with justice. The record of their words and deeds is preserved, and nothing of it is lost with Allah, and He will bring it all to account on the Day when every soul will be recompensed for what it earned, and the wrongdoers will find no helper.

phrases.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيۡسَ بِظَلَّامٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
phrases.translation: This is ˹the reward˺ for what your hands have done. And Allah is never unjust to ˹His˺ creation.”
phrases.explanation: "This is the reward for what your hands have done. And Allah is never unjust to His creation." "That is because of what your hands have sent forth before": the punishment of the Fire is the recompense of the deeds of the disbelievers, their disbelief and their killing of the prophets, and Allah is never unjust to His creation, for He judges with justice, and whoever wrongs himself will find his recompense with Him. So fear Him and do good, for He sees what you do. And the believer will be rewarded for his good deeds in full. So do not wrong anyone, for Allah is the Just.

phrases.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَلَّا نُؤۡمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَنَا بِقُرۡبَانٖ تَأۡكُلُهُ ٱلنَّارُۗ قُلۡ قَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّن قَبۡلِي بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلَّذِي قُلۡتُمۡ فَلِمَ قَتَلۡتُمُوهُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
phrases.translation: Those ˹are the same people˺ who say, “Allah has commanded us not to believe in any messenger unless he brings us an offering to be consumed by fire ˹from the sky˺.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Other prophets did in fact come to you before me with clear proofs and ˹even˺ what you demanded—why then did you kill them, if what you say is true?”
phrases.explanation: "Those are the same people who say: Allah has commanded us not to believe in any messenger unless he brings us an offering to be consumed by fire. Truly, messengers before him came to you with clear proofs and the divine Books and enlightening Scriptures. So if you are truthful, why did you kill them before?" These are the same Jews who claimed that Allah made a covenant with them not to believe in any messenger unless he brings a burnt offering. But messengers before Muhammad came to them with clear proofs, scriptures, and enlightening books, so if their claim were true, why did they kill the earlier prophets. Their claim is false, and they killed the messengers out of arrogance and envy.

phrases.ar: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٞ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ جَآءُو بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُنِيرِ
phrases.translation: If you are rejected by them, so too were messengers before you who came with clear proofs, divine Books, and enlightening Scriptures
phrases.explanation: "If you are rejected by them, so too were messengers before you who came with clear proofs, divine Books, and enlightening Scriptures." If the people reject you, O Muhammad, then know that messengers before you were also rejected, and they came with clear proofs, the divine books, and the enlightening scriptures, and were still denied, so be patient, for patience is the way of the messengers, and Allah will aid you against those who deny you. So do not grieve, for Allah is with the patient. And Allah supports His messengers and their followers with victory. So hold fast to your religion and do not turn back. And success is with Allah alone.

phrases.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۗ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوۡنَ أُجُورَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ فَمَن زُحۡزِحَ عَنِ ٱلنَّارِ وَأُدۡخِلَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ فَقَدۡ فَازَۗ وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡغُرُورِ
phrases.translation: Every soul will taste death. And you will only receive your full reward on the Day of Judgment. Whoever is spared from the Fire and is admitted into Paradise will ˹indeed˺ triumph, whereas the life of this world is no more than the delusion of enjoyment
phrases.explanation: "Every soul will taste death. And you will only receive your full reward on the Day of Judgment. Whoever is spared from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has truly succeeded. This life is only a deceptive enjoyment." Every soul tastes death, and no one is exempt. You will be paid your full reward only on the Day of Resurrection, each according to his deeds. Whoever is removed from the Fire and admitted into Paradise has attained the great victory, and the success is with Allah. The worldly life is only a deceptive enjoyment that distracts from the Hereafter, so do not be deluded by it, but prepare for the meeting with Allah.

phrases.ar: ۞ لَتُبۡلَوُنَّ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِكُمۡ وَأَنفُسِكُمۡ وَلَتَسۡمَعُنَّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُوٓاْ أَذٗى كَثِيرٗاۚ وَإِن تَصۡبِرُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ فَإِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
phrases.translation: You ˹believers˺ will surely be tested in your wealth and yourselves, and you will certainly hear many hurtful words from those who were given the Scripture before you and ˹from˺ the polytheists. But if you are patient and mindful ˹of Allah˺—surely this is a resolve to aspire to
phrases.explanation: "You believers will surely be tested in your wealth and yourselves, and you will certainly hear many hurtful words from those who were given the Scripture before you and from the polytheists. But if you are patient and mindful of Allah, that is the best course." This was revealed, it is said, concerning a Jew who reviled the Prophet. Allah tells the believers they will be tested in their wealth, by spending in His cause and losing it, and in themselves, by being harmed and killed, and they will hear hurtful words from the People of the Book and the polytheists. But if they are patient and fear Allah, enduring the harm without retaliating unlawfully, that is of the matters that require determination, and Allah will reward them for their patience.

phrases.ar: وَإِذۡ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَٰقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُۥ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَكۡتُمُونَهُۥ فَنَبَذُوهُ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمۡ وَٱشۡتَرَوۡاْ بِهِۦ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَا يَشۡتَرُونَ
phrases.translation: ˹Remember, O Prophet,˺ when Allah took the covenant of those who were given the Scripture to make it known to people and not hide it, yet they cast it behind their backs and traded it for a fleeting gain. What a miserable profit
phrases.explanation: "Remember, O Prophet, when Allah took the covenant of those who were given the Scripture to make it known to people and not hide it, but they threw it behind their backs and traded it for a miserable price. How evil is what they do!" Allah took a covenant from the People of the Book to explain their scripture to people and not conceal it, but they cast it behind their backs and exchanged it for a small price of this world. The exegetes differed over who is meant, some saying the Jews of Medina, but the warning is general: whoever hides the truth of his Book for worldly gain does an evil thing, and Allah will requite him for it, for the covenant of Allah binds them to convey the truth.

phrases.ar: لَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفۡرَحُونَ بِمَآ أَتَواْ وَّيُحِبُّونَ أَن يُحۡمَدُواْ بِمَا لَمۡ يَفۡعَلُواْ فَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّهُم بِمَفَازَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
phrases.translation: Do not let those who rejoice in their misdeeds and love to take credit for what they have not done think they will escape torment. They will suffer a painful punishment
phrases.explanation: "Do not let those who rejoice in their misdeeds and love to take credit for what they have not done think they will escape torment. They will suffer a painful punishment." Some said this was revealed concerning a group of hypocrites who stayed behind from the expedition and rejoiced at their staying, loving to be praised for what they did not do. Do not think, O Muhammad, that they will escape the punishment of Allah, for they rejoiced in evil and sought praise without deed, and they will have a painful punishment, for Allah knows their state and will requite them for their hypocrisy. Allah threatens them with a painful punishment and reminds you not to think well of them, for rejoicing in sin and seeking praise without work is hypocrisy, and whoever does it will not escape the torment of Allah, for He knows the hidden and the apparent, and He will requite every soul for what it earned. The exegetes said the rejoicing was over staying behind from battle while claiming to have participated, and their love of praise for what they did not do is the mark of the hypocrite, and Allah exposed them and threatened them with a painful punishment that will not be lightened, for they loved evil and shunned the good. So do not rejoice in sin, and do what earns praise.

phrases.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
phrases.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Most Capable of everything
phrases.explanation: "To Allah alone belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Most Capable of everything." The kingdom of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah alone, and He is able to do all things, including hastening the punishment for those who rejoice in evil, for He is All-Powerful over His creation, and nothing is beyond Him. So worship Him alone and seek His pleasure. He owns all dominion, does what He wills, and no one can repel His decree. So call upon Him and rely on Him, for He is the owner of the kingdom and the best of helpers. And to Him all will return.

phrases.ar: إِنَّ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
phrases.translation: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the day and night there are signs for people of reason
phrases.explanation: "Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the day and night there are signs for people of reason, those who remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: Our Lord, You have not created this in vain. Glory be to You, so protect us from the Fire of Hell." In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those of understanding, those who remember Allah in every state and reflect upon the creation, glorifying Allah and asking Him to save them from the Fire.

phrases.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَذۡكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمٗا وَقُعُودٗا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمۡ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلٗا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
phrases.translation: ˹They are˺ those who remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth ˹and pray˺, “Our Lord! You have not created ˹all of˺ this without purpose. Glory be to You! Protect us from the torment of the Fire
phrases.explanation: "They are those who remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: Our Lord, You have not created this in vain. Glory be to You, so protect us from the Fire. Our Lord, indeed those You commit to the Fire will be completely disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers." Those of understanding remember Allah in every posture and reflect on the creation, glorifying Him and asking Him to save them from the Fire. "You have not created this in vain": everything has a purpose and wisdom. "Whoever You commit to the Fire will be disgraced": he will be humiliated before all creation. "The wrongdoers will have no helpers": no one will aid them against Allah, for He is the helper of the believers and the humiliator of the disbelievers. And they ask Allah to protect them from the Fire. Their supplication is for protection from the Fire and entry into Paradise.

phrases.ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدۡخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدۡ أَخۡزَيۡتَهُۥۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارٖ
phrases.translation: Our Lord! Indeed, those You commit to the Fire will be ˹completely˺ disgraced! And the wrongdoers will have no helpers
phrases.explanation: "Our Lord! Indeed, those You commit to the Fire will be completely disgraced! And the wrongdoers will have no helpers." The prayer of the believers is: our Lord, whoever You admit into the Fire and make abide in it forever has been disgraced and humiliated, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers against Your punishment, for no one can avert the decree of Allah, and whoever disbelieves has no supporter. So seek refuge in Allah from the Fire. So do good and fear Allah, that you may be among the successful. And there is no helper for the wrongdoer against Allah. And whoever fears Allah is saved.

phrases.ar: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِيٗا يُنَادِي لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ أَنۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَـَٔامَنَّاۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ
phrases.translation: Our Lord! We have heard the caller to ˹true˺ belief, ˹proclaiming,˺ ‘Believe in your Lord ˹alone˺,’ so we believed. Our Lord! Forgive our sins, absolve us of our misdeeds, and allow us ˹each˺ to die as one of the virtuous
phrases.explanation: "Our Lord! We have heard the caller to true belief, proclaiming: Believe in your Lord alone, so we believed. Our Lord! Forgive our sins and efface from us our misdeeds. Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful." The believers say: our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith, proclaiming belief in Your oneness, and that caller is the Quran or the Messenger, and we believed and obeyed. Then they ask: our Lord, forgive us our sins and remove from us our evil deeds, for You are the Forgiving, the Merciful, who accepts repentance and overlooks sins. So hasten to faith and repentance. And He is the best of those who respond.

phrases.ar: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخۡزِنَا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
phrases.translation: Our Lord! Grant us what You have promised us through Your messengers and do not put us to shame on Judgment Day—for certainly You never fail in Your promise.”
phrases.explanation: "Our Lord! Grant us what You have promised us through Your messengers and do not put us to shame on Judgment Day, for certainly You never break Your promise." The believers ask Allah to give them what He promised through His messengers, namely Paradise, and not to disgrace them on the Day of Judgment, for He never breaks His promise. The exegetes differed whether this is a request or an assertion of confidence in the promise, but the meaning is trust in Allah's promise and asking Him to fulfill it. And trust in His promise, for He is true in His word. So ask Him boldly, for He is generous.

phrases.ar: فَٱسۡتَجَابَ لَهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ أَنِّي لَآ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَٰمِلٖ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰۖ بَعۡضُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡضٖۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخۡرِجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي
phrases.translation: So their Lord responded to them: “I will never deny any of you—male or female—the reward of your deeds. Both are equal in reward. Those who migrated or were expelled from their homes, and were persecuted
phrases.explanation: "So their Lord responded to them: I will never deny any of you, male or female, the reward of your deeds. Both are equal in reward. Those of you who emigrated, were persecuted, harmed, and killed in My cause, and fought and were killed: I will surely forgive your sins and admit you to Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the great triumph." Allah answered the believers: He will not waste the work of any worker among them, male or female, for both are equal in reward, and whoever emigrated for Allah, was persecuted, harmed, fought, or killed in His cause, He will forgive their sins and enter them into Paradise. It was said this was revealed when it was asked why only the men were mentioned, and the answer is that men and women are equal in reward. And entering Paradise is the supreme success.

phrases.ar: وَقَٰتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَلَأُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ ثَوَابٗا مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسۡنُ ٱلثَّوَابِ
phrases.translation: for My sake and fought and ˹some˺ were martyred—I will certainly forgive their sins and admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow, as a reward from Allah. And with Allah is the finest reward!”
phrases.explanation: "Those of you who emigrated, were persecuted, harmed, and killed in My cause, and fought and were killed: I will surely forgive your sins and admit you to Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the great triumph." For those who strive in the cause of Allah, whether by emigrating, enduring persecution, fighting, or being killed, Allah promises forgiveness of sins and admission to Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein, and that is the greatest attainment, for it combines forgiveness and Paradise. And Paradise is the abode of the righteous. And do not despair of the mercy of Allah. And the strugglers are honored in this world and the next.

phrases.ar: لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
phrases.translation: Do not be deceived by the prosperity of the disbelievers throughout the land
phrases.explanation: "Do not be deceived by the prosperity of the disbelievers throughout the land. It is only a brief enjoyment. Then Hell will be their home, what an evil place to rest." Allah forbids His Prophet from being deceived by the travels and trade of the disbelievers in the lands and by the respite He grants them. Their bustling is only a small enjoyment, temporary, and their abode on the Day of Judgment is Hell, what a wretched resting place. So do not envy them, for their end is the Fire. So do not be envious of them. And remember that the Hereafter is better and lasting. And their wealth will not avail them.

phrases.ar: مَتَٰعٞ قَلِيلٞ ثُمَّ مَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
phrases.translation: It is only a brief enjoyment. Then Hell will be their home—what an evil place to rest
phrases.explanation: "It is only a brief enjoyment. Then Hell will be their home, what an evil place to rest!" The going to and fro of the disbelievers through the lands is a meager enjoyment, brief and cut off, and their destination is Hell, what a wretched bed and couch, for they preferred this world over the Hereafter and will abide in the Fire forever. Their enjoyment will end, and their abode is eternal. So prepare for it with faith and good deeds, for it is the true life. So do not let it deceive you, but remember the Fire. And the Fire is prepared for them. So fear Allah and seek His refuge.

phrases.ar: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلٗا مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ لِّلۡأَبۡرَارِ
phrases.translation: But those who are mindful of their Lord will be in Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there forever—as an accommodation from Allah. And what is with Allah is best for the virtuous
phrases.explanation: "But those who are mindful of their Lord will be in Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there forever, as an accommodation from Allah. And Allah has with Him the best reward." In contrast to the disbelievers, the God-fearing have Gardens under which rivers flow, abiding forever, as a gift and honor from Allah, "from Allah" meaning from His side as part of the honor He bestows. And with Allah is the best reward, Paradise and His pleasure, the greatest of rewards, so strive to be among the God-fearing. So be mindful of your Lord in all your affairs. And He is the best of rewarders.

phrases.ar: وَإِنَّ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَمَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ
phrases.translation: Indeed, there are some among the People of the Book who truly believe in Allah and what has been revealed to you ˹believers˺ and what was
phrases.explanation: "Indeed, there are some among the People of the Book who truly believe in Allah and what has been revealed to you believers and what was revealed before you, establishing prayer and giving charity, and they will not deny the reward of Allah." Some said this was revealed concerning the Negus and those like him among the People of the Book who truly believe in Allah, the Quran, and the earlier scriptures, establish prayer, give charity, and do not deny the reward of Allah, for they are not like the majority who denied the Prophet. They are not like those who denied the truth. And they are among the successful. They feared Allah and did what He commanded. And they will be admitted to Paradise by the mercy of Allah. And their reward is with Allah, great and abundant.

phrases.ar: خَٰشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشۡتَرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
phrases.translation: revealed to them. They humble themselves before Allah—never trading Allah’s revelations for a fleeting gain. Their reward is with their Lord. Surely Allah is swift in reckoning
phrases.explanation: "They establish prayer and give charity, and they will not deny the reward of Allah. And Allah is All-Seeing of His servants, and for them is a great reward with their Lord, for they believed truly and did good, and Allah will reward them in full." These believers among the People of the Book establish prayer, give zakah, and do not disbelieve in the reward of Allah. Allah sees His servants and knows who believed truly, and for them is a great reward with their Lord, for Allah does not waste the reward of the believers. And Allah will not waste their reward. So be among them by believing truly.

phrases.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱصۡبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ
phrases.translation: O believers! Patiently endure, persevere, stand on guard, and be mindful of Allah,
phrases.explanation: "O believers! Patiently endure, persevere, stand on guard, and be mindful of Allah, so you may be successful." "Be patient": endure what befalls you in the cause of Allah. Some said: be patient upon your religion. "Persevere": be more steadfast than the disbelievers. "Stand on guard": keep watch against the enemy at the borders. "Be mindful of Allah": fear Him in secret and in public. So you may be successful, attaining Paradise by patience, steadfastness, and vigilance, for Allah loves the patient and the God-fearing. The exegetes differed over the meanings: some said "be patient" means be patient with your religion, others that it means be patient with jihad, and "persevere" means be more steadfast than your enemy, for the reciprocal form in Arabic means to outdo the other party. "Stand on guard" means keep guard against your enemies and the enemies of your religion at the borders, and others said it means persevere in the prayers, awaiting one after another. All the meanings point to steadfastness in obedience and guarding the religion of Allah. And "be mindful of Allah, so you may be successful": fear Allah in secret and in public, for success and Paradise are for the God-fearing and the patient, and Allah loves those who are patient and those who do good. This is the final verse of the surah, and it is a comprehensive command to the believers to combine patience, steadfastness against the enemy, guarding the borders and the prayers, and God-fearingness, for in these four is the success of this world and the next, and Allah has promised success to those who have them, so hold fast to them until you meet your Lord. The Prophet taught that whoever dies upon patience and guarding the deen is a martyr in the cause of Allah, and the believer should therefore hold fast to these qualities in every circumstance, whether in ease or hardship, in health or sickness, for they are the shield of the believer against the plots of Satan and the enemy, and the means of entering Paradise with the pleasure of Allah, so do not neglect them, and ask Allah to make you among those who are patient and steadfast. And whoever holds to them will never be forsaken.

phrases.ar: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
phrases.translation: so you may be successful
phrases.explanation: "Stand on guard, and be mindful of Allah, so you may be successful." Keep guard against your enemy and be mindful of Allah in all states, for success is with those who are patient and God-fearing, and Allah aids them. And whoever is mindful of Allah in all states attains success and Paradise, the best of rewards. And Allah is with the patient. And success is with those who are God-fearing. And Allah suffices the believers. So hold fast to the deen until the end. Keep guard at the borders of the Muslim lands and in the prayers, and fear Allah in secret and in public, for that is the way of success promised by your Lord.
